Author: Null
Name: Chocobo Color Calculator
Punchline: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Description: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Changelog: Improved route accuracy with a reliable-target policy. Desert Yellow to Soot Black now uses the established 19-apple, 23-pear, 32-berry route, with narrow-color guidance and new regression coverage.
